Definition: tenth; by abbreviation, tenth month or (feminine) part
BiblicalUsage: This word counts tenths, and it turns up in three different corners of the law and the calendar. It marks the tenth generation barred from the congregation, the tenth part of an ephah offered by Aaron and his sons, the tenth month when the mountain tops were seen after the flood, and the fast of the tenth month that Zechariah says will become joy.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the tenth keeps showing up because God claims a portion of everything, time and grain and generations alike. The fasts that once marked judgment would turn to feasting, and I hold that the God who counts tenths is the same God who turns mourning into joy.
